    /* ─── STATS ─── */
    .stats { background: var(--color-text); color: #fff; padding: 5rem 1.5rem; }
    .stats-inner { max-width: 900px; margin: 0 auto; text-align: center; }
    .stats-eyebrow {
      font-size: 0.8125rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.45);
      margin-bottom: 0.875rem;
    }
    .stats-headline {
      font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3.5vw, 2.25rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: -0.025em;
      line-height: 1.25;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.95);
      margin-bottom: 3.5rem;
    }
    .stats-grid {
      display: grid;

    /* ─── FEATURES: SEARCH ─── */
    .features-search { padding: 6rem 1.5rem; }
    .features-search-inner { max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto; }
    .feature-header { margin-bottom: 3rem; }
    .search-demo {
      background: var(--color-surface-2);
      border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .search-top {
      padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 1rem;
      background: var(--color-bg);
    }
    .search-input-wrap {
      flex: 1;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.625rem;
      background: var(--color-surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 0.5rem 0.875rem;
      max-width: 400px;
    }
    .search-input-wrap svg { color: var(--color-text-subtle); flex-shrink: 0; }

      font-size: 0.875rem;
      color: var(--color-text-subtle);

    }
    .search-tabs {

    .search-tab {
      padding: 0.4375rem 0.875rem;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      cursor: pointer;
      border: none;
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--color-text-muted);
      white-space: nowrap;
      transition: background var(--transition), color var(--transition);
      font-family: var(--font);
      min-height: 44px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
    }
    .search-tab:hover { background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-text); }
    .search-tab.active {
      background: var(--color-text);
      color: #fff;
    }
    .filter-row {
      display: flex;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      padding: 1rem 1.5rem;
      overflow-x: auto;
      scrollbar-width: none;
      background: var(--color-bg);
    }
    .filter-row::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
    .filter-pill {
      padding: 0.375rem 0.875rem;
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      font-size: 0.8125rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      cursor: pointer;
      border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
      background: var(--color-bg);
      color: var(--color-text-muted);
      white-space: nowrap;
      transition: all var(--transition);
      font-family: var(--font);
      min-height: 32px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
    }
    .filter-pill:hover { border-color: var(--color-text); color: var(--color-text); }
    .filter-pill.active {
      background: var(--color-text);
      border-color: var(--color-text);
      color: #fff;
    }
    .screenshot-grid {
      padding: 1.25rem;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(130px, 1fr));
      gap: 10px;
    }
    .screenshot-card {
      aspect-ratio: 9/18;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      overflow: hidden;
      position: relative;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: transform var(--transition), box-shadow var(--transition);
    }
    .screenshot-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }
    .screenshot-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

    /* Tab content panels */
    .tab-panel { display: none; }
    .tab-panel.active { display: block; }

    .ui-elements-grid {
      padding: 1.5rem;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(160px, 1fr));
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .ui-element-card {
      height: 100px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
      background: var(--color-bg);

      flex-direction: column;

      justify-content: center;

    .ui-element-label { font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--color-text-muted); font-weight: 500; }

    .flows-grid { padding: 1.5rem; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(200px, 1fr)); gap: 12px; }
    .flow-card {
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
      overflow: hidden;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: transform var(--transition), box-shadow var(--transition);
    }
    .flow-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); }
    .flow-card-preview {
      height: 110px;
      background: var(--color-surface);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 6px;
      padding: 12px;

      flex: 1;
      height: 80px;
      border-radius: 5px;

    .flow-card-footer {
      padding: 0.625rem 0.75rem;

    .flow-card-name { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-text); }

    .text-search-panel { padding: 1.5rem; }

    /* ─── FEATURES: FLOWS ─── */
    .features-flows { padding: 6rem 1.5rem; background: var(--color-surface-2); }

      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 4rem;
      align-items: center;

<script>
  // ─── MOBILE MENU ───
  const menuBtn = document.getElementById('navMenuBtn');
  const navLinks = document.getElementById('navLinks');
  menuBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const open = navLinks.classList.toggle('open');
    menuBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open);
  });

  // ─── STATS COUNTER ───
  function easeOutExpo(t) {
    return t === 1 ? 1 : 1 - Math.pow(2, -10 * t);
  }

  function formatNumber(n) {
    return n.toLocaleString('en-US');
  }

  function animateCounter(el, target, duration, delay) {
    setTimeout(() => {
      const start = performance.now();
      function tick(now) {
        const elapsed = now - start;
        const progress = Math.min(elapsed / duration, 1);
        const eased = easeOutExpo(progress);
        const current = Math.round(eased * target);
        el.textContent = formatNumber(current);
        if (progress < 1) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      }
      requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    }, delay);
  }

  const statsObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        statsObserver.disconnect();
        const appsEl = document.getElementById('stat-apps');
        const screensEl = document.getElementById('stat-screens');
        const flowsEl = document.getElementById('stat-flows');
        animateCounter(appsEl,    1150,   1400, 0);
        animateCounter(screensEl, 615900, 1800, 200);
        animateCounter(flowsEl,   329200, 1800, 400);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.4 });

  statsObserver.observe(document.getElementById('stats-section'));

  // ─── SEARCH TABS ───
  function switchTab(tab) {
    const tabs = document.querySelectorAll('.search-tab');
    const panels = document.querySelectorAll('.tab-panel');

    tabs.forEach(t => {
      const isActive = t.id === 'tab-' + tab;
      t.classList.toggle('active', isActive);
      t.setAttribute('aria-selected', isActive);
    });

    panels.forEach(p => {
      const isActive = p.id === 'panel-' + (tab === 'ui' ? 'ui' : tab === 'flows' ? 'flows' : tab === 'text' ? 'text' : 'screens');
      p.classList.toggle('active', isActive);
      if (isActive) {
        p.removeAttribute('hidden');
      } else {
        p.setAttribute('hidden', '');
      }
    });
  }

  // ─── FILTER PILLS ───
  function selectPill(pill) {
    const pills = document.querySelectorAll('.filter-pill');
    pills.forEach(p => {
      p.classList.remove('active');
      p.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
    });
    pill.classList.add('active');
    pill.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');

    // Animate grid items on category change
    const grid = document.querySelector('#panel-screens .screenshot-grid');
    if (grid && document.getElementById('panel-screens').classList.contains('active')) {
      grid.style.opacity = '0.4';
      grid.style.transition = 'opacity 150ms ease';
      setTimeout(() => {
        grid.style.opacity = '1';
      }, 200);
    }
  }

  // ─── FLOWS TOGGLE ───
  function switchFlows(mode) {
    const btns = document.querySelectorAll('.flows-toggle-btn');
    const panels = document.querySelectorAll('.flows-visual-panel');
    const videoFeat = document.getElementById('flows-feat-video');
    const protoFeat = document.getElementById('flows-feat-proto');

    btns.forEach(b => {
      const isActive = b.id === 'flows-btn-' + mode;
      b.classList.toggle('active', isActive);
      b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', isActive);
    });

    panels.forEach(p => {
      const isActive = p.id === 'flows-panel-' + mode;
      p.classList.toggle('active', isActive);
    });

    if (mode === 'videos') {
      videoFeat.style.display = 'flex';
      protoFeat.style.display = 'none';
    } else {
      videoFeat.style.display = 'none';
      protoFeat.style.display = 'flex';
    }
  }

  // ─── PAUSE MARQUEES ON HOVER ───
  document.querySelectorAll('.marquee-track, .app-marquee-track').forEach(track => {
    track.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => { track.style.animationPlayState = 'paused'; });
    track.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => { track.style.animationPlayState = 'running'; });
  });
</script>

</body>
